## Who can apply?

If you're building towards one of these use cases, you may be eligible to join Notion's Security & Compliance partner program.

### Security Incident and Events Management (SIEM)

Monitoring to help organizations detect, analyze, and respond to incidents and security threats.

[Learn more](https://notion.com/help/guides/notion-enterprise-security-provisions#siem-integrations)

### Data Loss Prevention

Safeguarding sensitive data from unauthorized access or breaches.

[Learn more](https://notion.com/help/guides/notion-enterprise-security-provisions#dlp-integrations)

### eDiscovery (Collections, Legal Hold)

Streamlining the process of locating, securing and searching electronic data for legal proceedings.

### Data Backup (Export)

Ensuring data safety through backup and export procedures.

## Notion for Enterprises

As Notion serves more enterprise customers, the needs of our users and admins evolve. Together with our partners, we’ve been hard at work designing a new, more complete Enterprise experience to make sure we check all the boxes.

[Learn more](https://notion.com/enterprise)

## Benefits for our program partners.

### API access

Get access to Notion's Discovery API and documentation, including our Partner Onboarding wiki.

### Notion Academy

Join the Notion Academy with exclusive product training for our partners.

### Dedicated support

Join a shared Slack channel where you'll get direct support from Notion's Business Development and Partner Engineering team.

### Co-Marketing

List your integration in Notion's Integration Gallery, get an in-product placement inside Notion, access to marketing collateral and more.

[Explore integrations](https://notion.com/product/wikis)

## Questions & answers

I'm interested in becoming a Security and Compliance partner. How do I apply?

Please apply to our Technology Partner Program using [this form](https://notionup.typeform.com/to/DWbNQjjE?typeform-source=www.notion.so) and for the question "What partner category do you fall into?", select "Security & Compliance partner".

I submitted my interest in becoming a Security and Compliance partner; when can I expect to hear back?

We're not accepting new applications to the Security and Compliance Partner Program right now. If you'd like, you can still share more about your company and integration in the form above, and we'll reach out as soon as the program reopens.

What are the requirements for becoming a Notion Security and Compliance partner?

Eligible Security and Compliance partners will need to reach a threshold of shared customers of Notion, specialize in a supported security and compliance use case as outlined on this page, and have plans to build a Notion integration for shared customers.

What are the benefits of being in the program?

Admitted Security and Compliance partners will have access to Discovery API documentation through our Notion workspace. You'll also have access to our Business Development and Partner Engineering teams and co-marketing opportunities.

I haven't built an integration with Notion yet. Where do I start?

You can build a public integration using our developer documentation for public APIs [here](https://developers.notion.com/). We'll share more information about our Discovery API once you are admitted to the Security and Compliance Partner Program.
